notes: The lead's entity is a national aggregate (92 non-JFC PACs, $580M from individuals, 2024, under 10% passed through; 12 busiest treasurers hold 29 of 96). No source found with that screen, that count or that treasurer-concentration statistic. Closest is Bonica (Aug 2025 and Aug 2026) plus The Nation (Aug 2026): same low-pass-through pattern, but Democratic-aligned only, multi-cycle, and 'spam PAC' defined by fundraising-cost share rather than an all-PAC under-10% cut. OpenSecrets 2023 piece identified 86 potential scam PACs in the 2022 cycle (per search snippet; opensecrets.org returned HTTP 403 so not quoted). justice.gov and fbi.gov pages on the Robert Piaro scam-PAC treasurer plea (SDNY) could not be fetched (empty/403), so not recorded; it covers 2017-2022 activity anyway. The Hill 'How to spot a scam PAC' (2024) returned 403. Bulwark and NYT reportedly declined to run Bonica's piece after consultant pushback (per search snippets, not opened).
